title: Inspect exact line context before count-sensitive source patches
trigger_preconditions: A patch targets long generated-style list lines whose wrapping may differ from the proposed context.
failure_signature: The task-count adjustment patch found no exact matching context and changed nothing.
candidate_workaround: Read the exact target lines first and apply a smaller uniquely anchored replacement.
recurrence_guard: Do not patch long list literals from remembered wrapping; anchor against the current file text.
rollback: Treat the rejected patch as zero change and preserve the pre-patch file unchanged.
scope_boundary: Owner-local source editing only; no scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
